newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-HAMPSHIRE SIGN HAYDEN, WALSH SET TO STAY WITH GLOUCESTER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HAMPSHIRE SIGN HAYDEN, WALSH SET TO STAY WITH GLOUCESTER.

text.p: Hampshire have signed Australian opening batsman Matthew Hayden as their overseas player for next season.
The Queensland vice-captain has scored over 7,000 runs in his career at an average of 57 -- a better record than anyone currently playing first class cricket in Australia.
Meanwhile, West Indies test captain Courtney Walsh has agreed a new two-year contract with Gloucestershire.
The deal is now subject to Walsh's obligations to his country's board of control, who also want him to help develop their domestic game.
"We have shaken hands on the deal to extend his contract until the end of the 1998 season," Gloucestershire's chief executive Philip August said on Tuesday.
